note: Anonymised design-system interpretations. Placeholder copy only — not the work of any named company.

items.name: Replicate
items.label: Ember Works
items.blurb: The system reads as "AI lab notebook crossed with print magazine": cream and bone surfaces, dark ink type, monospace code wells, irregular hand-drawn-feeling diagrams, and a rich orange used scarcely on the most consequential CTA.

items.name: Ferrari
items.label: Ember Studio
items.blurb: A luxury-automotive brand whose marketing surfaces read as cinematic editorial.
notes: The brand's strongest visual signature is the **full-bleed cinematic hero photograph** that fills the viewport top with car photography, model details, or trackside livery — followed by a tighter editorial body layout below.

items.name: Composio
items.label: Cobalt Works
items.blurb: abcDiatype carries display and body in a single sans family with weights 400-600.
notes: The brand's strongest visual signature is a four-pane terminal-style mockup (a 2×2 grid of dark code/output panels) with a central blue spotlight glow — used as the homepage hero anchor.

items.name: PlayStation
items.label: Cobalt Field
items.blurb: The system never decorates — no gradient backgrounds on chrome, no atmospheric mesh, no drop shadows beyond a faint section-divide.

items.name: Shopifi
items.label: Ink Press
items.blurb: a cinematic commerce platform that runs two parallel design tracks.

items.name: Slacc
items.label: Violet Method
items.blurb: a workplace messaging brand built on a deep aubergine primary, with cream-lavender hero gradients, blue inline links, and pill CTAs.
notes: The system pairs a proprietary humanist sans for display with a separate utility sans for body, and stages product UI mockups inside soft pastel-mesh hero composites that act as both decoration and feature explanation.

items.name: Linear
items.label: Cobalt Press
items.blurb: The system reads as software-craft documentation: dense, technical, and quietly luxurious.
notes: Cards live as charcoal panels (#0f1011) with hairline borders.
The accent lavender appears on the brand mark, focus rings, and a few intentional CTAs — never decoratively.

items.name: Apple
items.label: Cobalt Studio
items.blurb: A photography-first interface that turns marketing into a museum gallery.
notes: UI chrome recedes so the product can speak — no decorative gradients, no shadows on chrome, only the one signature drop-shadow under product imagery resting on a surface.
